name: de-treaty-withholding-rates
description: Use this skill when a German company, bank or licensee pays dividends, interest or royalties to a person outside Germany, tax year 2026. Covers the domestic withholding (Kapitalertragsteuer 25% plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge, 26.375% in all; § 50a 15% on royalties), the treaty limits for Germany's main partners (Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands, France, Italy, Spain, UK, Ireland, Luxembourg, US, Poland, Czech Republic) read from the treaty texts, the exemption certificate and refund at the BZSt (§ 50c EStG), the EU Parent-Subsidiary exemption (§ 43b), the Interest and Royalties exemption (§ 50g), the two-fifths refund for foreign companies (§ 44a(9)) and the anti-treaty-shopping rule (§ 50d(3)). Trigger on: Quellensteuer Deutschland, Kapitalertragsteuer Erstattung, Freistellungsbescheinigung, § 50c, § 43b, § 50g, § 50d Abs. 3, DBA Quellensteuersatz, German withholding tax rate treaty. Out of scope: assessing non-residents (de-non-resident-tax), foreign tax on a German resident's incom
